The hidden gem in a hem.
Feb 2023 • Friends
My wife and I first found this bar last August so it was a no brainer to bring some of friends here on our next trip. The quality and quantity of drinks has improved, which was difficult to do, the atmosphere is still fantastic but the most amazing thing was the staff remembered us. You feel at home in this gorgeous bar hidden down a hem and they even have pizzas on the menu now, which were very good mind you. One of the bar tenders, Bong, some nights sung for us and even let us join in but I don't think she will again ha ha. Overall if you are looking for a place away from the girly bars in Bui Vien this is the place to go, you can talk to your friends and the staff will answer any questions you have on what to do and where to go whilst in Saigon. A beautifully designed bar with a heritage feel and comfortable stools. Great place.
